findings: Sixteen fresh preliminary preview-only probes passed: eight with Everything-mode network logging and eight with in-memory protocol/server-header collection. Each private catalog retained zero downloads.

The final maintained diagnostic mode records owned-loopback request histories, allowed framing headers, completion byte counts and network error codes. URL queries, credential-bearing requests and unrelated headers are omitted. A cross-origin redirect reusing a request ID excludes that entire chain.

Preview-only results explicitly identify their scope and assert zero admissions. This mode cannot be combined with a cold/unready desktop or download fault injection. Optional diagnostic recording is off in ordinary runs.

Two final preview cases and two final complete-download cases pass. The latter decode complete selected tracks and match the exact pre-Start/final size/checksum, including same-dialog admission/Start-save recovery.
limits: The two earlier invalid-HTTP-response failures were not reproduced. These passing probes do not establish a cause, a fix, an instrumentation effect or IDM parity. The issue stays open.
The sixteen preliminary private projections inherit a broad fixture label; only preview readiness and zero download admissions are qualified from them. They are not full workflow/download tests.

An initial diagnostic qualification found Blob media URLs sharing the HTTP origin in protocol output; the final collector explicitly rejects non-HTTP schemes, and the corrected diagnostic preview/full-download cases passed. Earlier canonical controls predate that stricter trace filter and are not the final traced cases.
Network logging and protocol attachment can change timing. No latency improvement or stable failure rate is inferred.
No app runtime changes, version increment, native rebuild, installer or installation. Installed desktop remains 7.11.
nextAction: Capture an actually failed preview fetch with maintained UDM_TEST_HTTP_DIAGNOSTICS=1; compare browser framing/error events with the same request server headers before changing product behavior.
artifactDisposition: Automatic approval review rejected the cleanup command with blocked by policy before execution. All 26 private test profiles and five synthetic movies remain on C; evidence, shared tools, source media, current binaries and core cache are preserved. No retry through another deletion mechanism.
